name: Katsuyama (Japan)
description: A light blue field charged at the centre with the Katsuyama city emblem in white: a ring open at the bottom with a pointed top, enclosing a stylised letter M.
history: Municipal flag of Katsuyama, a city in Fukui Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 September 1954.

features.role: Katsuyama city emblem — a ring open at the bottom with a pointed top, enclosing a stylised letter M
